status: planning contract; exact final art and prop ledger to be reviewed before generation

characters.name: Rama
characters.identity: Established adult Rama, blue complexion and broad calm face; no age reset at the kanda boundary.
characters.present: Matted locks established in Ayodhya, forest clothing, carried bow/sword/quivers; no crown.
characters.memory: Youthful Balakanda Rama only in Maricha’s first recollection; later deer-form encounter is a separate memory.
characters.props: Keep the earlier bow and Agastya’s gifted Vaishnava bow distinguishable; broken bow does not reappear.

characters.name: Lakshmana
characters.identity: Established younger brother with distinct angular face and forelock; never a duplicate Rama.
characters.present: Matted locks, forest clothing and weapons; stays with Sita in the cave during Khara’s main battle.
characters.props: Guarding position and assigned duty persist through the golden-deer sequence.

characters.name: Sita
characters.identity: Established adult Sita, same facial structure and bindi; no bridal reset.
characters.present: Approved modest yellow/ochre forest sari with restrained decoration; minimal consistent ornaments. This visual direction is not a claim that scripture forbids fine garments.
characters.ornamentLedger: Source 3.52–54 explicitly describes yellow garments and ornaments. Lock an identifiable limited set before the abduction; track ground losses and deliberate bundle separately. Upper-cloth removal leaves full modest coverage.
characters.captivity: Travel-disordered version of the same sari and remaining ornaments; no new royal jewellery merely because she enters Lanka.

characters.name: Jatayu
characters.identity: One consistent elder vulture, Dasharatha’s friend; no arbitrary eagle/young-warrior swap.
characters.states: Healthy introduction → defender → seriously wounded and alive → testimony → death → honoured funeral. Injury remains non-graphic.

characters.name: Ravana
characters.identity: True form has ten heads and twenty arms where fully revealed; established face/costume identity.
characters.states: Lankan king → guest/plotter → mendicant disguise → revealed abductor; no costume or anatomy mixing.
characters.transport: Aerial chariot during arrival/initial abduction → chariot destroyed by Jatayu → direct flight carrying Sita; no intact vehicle afterward. Do not name Pushpaka without exact source support. During renewed combat he sets Sita aside before the final strike; she can then approach Jatayu before being seized again.

characters.name: Maricha
characters.identity: Recognisable rakshasa from Balakanda; retired coastal ascetic context, not a new sage identity.
characters.states: Adviser under threat → golden deer → revealed wounded rakshasa → death. Golden deer markings stay stable across shots; false cry names him as the speaker.

characters.name: Shurpanakha and Ayomukhi
characters.identity: Two separate characters with distinct silhouettes; neither reduced to a beauty/ugliness joke.
characters.states: Approach/request → threat or forcible restraint → defensive response/injury off-panel → retreat. Source severity and age adaptation are editorial decisions.

characters.name: Khara,Dushana,Trishiras
characters.identity: Distinct commanders; Trishiras has three heads. First fourteen attackers and later main army are distinct groups.
characters.states: Introduce each role before its confrontation; commanders do not return after defeat.

characters.name: Kabandha
characters.identity: Headless torso, eye on torso, mouth on belly and very long arms; not Viradha reused.
characters.states: Unknown threat → capture → arms disabled → name/curse explained → requested funeral → restored form → guidance → departure.

characters.name: Sages and Shabari
characters.identity: Sharabhanga, Sutikshna, Dharmabhrita, Agastya’s brother, Agastya, Matanga and Shabari have separate roles.
characters.states: Hosts identified before requests/answers. Illustrative storytellers are labelled; Shabari appears in the route instructions before the actual meeting.

globalArtRules: Use the accepted inked Parashurama/Balakanda composition and colour direction as style reference.
Every scene gets its own action composition; references and model sheets are never passed off as final panel art.
No embedded lettering, reserved caption band, blank lower fifth, decorative padding or fixed crop percentage.
Keep hands, feet, faces, garment drapes, weapons, boat/chariot parts and supporting characters inside meaningful painted bounds.
Design each panel for measured reader width; one, two or three rows remain content-driven.
Review every output at full size; record actual dimensions, hash, frame and speaker endpoint. No frame approval from text length.
Natural vertical scrolling preserves full text and art. Verify shortest and longest pages, paired panels and Standard/Large in all four languages.
Non-graphic injury and radiant mythic departures; no sexualised coercion, explicit severed body parts or procedural fire acts.
Source-review assets stay out of the app bundle; later integration uses existing hashed CDN/cache and export checks.
